temporal_offsets.limitation: Date-boundary offsets are not event-time offsets when the event timestamp is unknown.

water.reason: Landslide grading is not a floodwater reference

limitations: Possible debris/disturbance is unvalidated; overlap is satellite-reference agreement, not physical destruction or confirmed road closure.
Unobservable pixels and unassessed assets remain unknown, never negatives.
AOI polygons alone do not establish assessment coverage or known negatives.
Nearest-neighbour raster alignment and pixel-centre polygon rasterization are used; areas are projected square metres.
Only the positive landslide footprint is assessed; precision, IoU and F1 are unavailable without explicit assessment coverage.
Road metrics retain the registered geometry-matching policy; unobservable roads are reported separately and recall is not an observed-only comparison.
